title: Oomwoo, an open-source robot vacuum you build yourself
summary: Oomwoo is a fully open-source robot vacuum project that DIY enthusiasts can build themselves using accessible components, 3D-printed parts, and open-source software, offering an affordable alternative to expensive commercial robot vacuums.
problem_solved: Provides an affordable, customizable alternative to expensive proprietary robot vacuums for hobbyists and makers.
why_valuable: It democratizes robotics technology by enabling anyone to learn, customize, and build their own smart home device while saving money.
